hero.intro: I’m Nadiia, a frontend developer with commercial experience in building modern web applications using React, Next.js, Angular and TypeScript. I like clean code, fewer dependencies and interfaces that feel obvious to use.

frontend.title: Frontend development
frontend.text: I build web applications with React, Next.js, Angular and TypeScript, with clean code and minimal dependencies.

responsive.title: Responsive and accessible UI
responsive.text: I make interfaces that work smoothly on desktop, tablet and mobile, with user-friendly design.

testing.title: Testing and documentation
testing.text: I write component and e2e tests (Vitest, React Testing Library, Cypress) and document components in Storybook.
